GoannaWatch - module GoannaWatch
Provides GoannaWatch management functionality, including GoannaWatch creation, login, and session tracking, along with the JavaFX UI controllers that drive the application's screens.
GoannaWatch - package GoannaWatch
Contains the main class of the account.App application that runs the JavaFx program.
GoannaWatch.account.controller - package GoannaWatch.account.controller
Contains the classes that handle the JavaFX GUI for the Account application.
GoannaWatch.account.model - package GoannaWatch.account.model
Contains the model classes that represent the account data of the application.
GoannaWatch.observations.controller - package GoannaWatch.observations.controller
Contains the classes that handle the JavaFX GUI for the Observation pages in the application.
GoannaWatch.observations.model - package GoannaWatch.observations.model
Contains the model classes that represent the observation data of the application.
